issue.title: Show derived clan wave placement in sase agent show and editor agent-list entries
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Proposed by sase-1lc.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes #5 and #6, merged here because they
share one root: clan wave placement is only consumed by the TUI). Both items are v2
non-goals in the epic plan `plan:202610/clan_waves_in_agents_tab.md`:

- "A wave line in `sase agent show`."
- "Wave fields in the editor integration (`src/sase/integrations/_agent_list_entry_build.py`)."

Epic sase-1lc derives clan waves in sase-core (`project_clan_waves`, binding
`sase_core_rs.project_clan_waves`) and shows them only in the Agents tab. The CLI and
the editor integration (sase-nvim via `sase agent list` entries) cannot tell a user which
wave a clan member is in, whether a clan is layered, or what a member waits on.

Proposal: expose the derived wave placement (wave number / seal / unresolved, and the
in-clan predecessors) on non-TUI surfaces: a `Wave:` line in `sase agent show` for clan
members of layered clans, and optional wave fields on agent-list entries for editor
integrations. Reuse the sase-core projection; do not re-derive waves in Python (see the
Rust core backend boundary rule).

Dependency: sase-1lc's landing found that the current core wire returns only partial
layout data (Python still derives rank, the layered flag, and the ghost split) and is
realigning it in a child epic of sase-1lc. Build on the realigned wire once that lands.
